paite: TOUPA ah ka ginna ka nga zel a, bangchidan ahia ka hinna kiang a, "Na tang ah vasa bang in lengmang in chi na hi ua?
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La / TOUPA A Muanna
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

paite: En dih ua, lungtang diktak pu mial nuai a akaptheihna ding un, migilou-saloute'n thalpeu alai ua, athal uah akhau ah abulh chiat uhi;
english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

paite: Suangphumte hihsiat a-omleh, midiktat in bang ahia ahihtheih ding?"
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

paite: TOUPA atempul siangthou ah a-om a, TOUPA laltutphah leng van ah a-om; mihing tate amit in a-en a, amit in a-enchian zel hi.
english: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

paite: TOUPA'N midiktat a-enchian zel a; migilou-salou leh hiamgamna deihte bel ahinna in ahua hi.
english: Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

paite: Migilou-saloute tung ah thang akesak ding a; mei leh kaat leh huih mulkimhuaitak a nou tan ding uh ahi ding hi.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

paite: TOUPA lah adiktat ngal a; diktatna adeih naknak hi; midiktatte'n amel amu ding uhi.
english: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
